company.name: Kestral
company.shortDescription: Kestral Computing designs, develops, tests, and supports radiology information system and pathology laboratory system (PLS) solutions.
company.description: Kestral Computing designs, develops, tests, markets, and supports radiology information system (RIS) and pathology laboratory system (PLS) solutions for the health industry in Australia and New Zealand. It offers Karisma, an RIS solution to schedule examinations, book resources, batch Medicare claims, and manage patient accounts; HL7Connect, an HL7 messaging interface that enables communication between HL7-compliant applications; and Clinical Integration System, an application that enables the retrieval of medical information from existing local and remote sources through a browser interface. The company also provides PLS, an information management solution for pathology; and Radiology Management System, an information system for radiology practices in hospital and private practice environment.
